title: Complete Identification of Interventions from Structural Zeros in Quasi-Markovian Models
banked_reason: The advertised support-scoped do-search compiler is not delivered, so the semantic tensor test still requires potentially enormous response-space matrices and has no termination, complexity, or certificate-size guarantee.
gap_reasons: The advertised support-scoped do-search compiler is not delivered, so the semantic tensor test still requires potentially enormous response-space matrices and has no termination, complexity, or certificate-size guarantee.
The presolve enumeration and software evidence are absent from the delivered note, leaving only two hand-worked controls and weakening reproducibility and practical significance.
The novelty case needs a theorem-level comparison with Zaffalon et al. (2020), whose Theorem 2 already gives exact rootwise credal representations for quasi-Markovian models.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 proved the exact-support maximal response chart, supported district-signature recovery, the tensor row-span identification iff on the canonical quasi-Markovian class, rational same-law interior twins, rational functionals, and fixed-face inference; it also added the converse-only transfer to ambient supermodels. The field-tier claim collapsed because the proposed support-scoped do-search compiler, its termination and certificate bounds, and reproducible implementation evidence remained undelivered; those are substantial new work, while the proved mathematical core was judged sound but incremental.
tldr: Exact structural zeros are identifying information inside the canonical quasi-Markovian class \(\Theta_S\), which has one mutually independent finite response root per bidirected-clique district. First-forbidden-prefix saturation gives its unique maximal Cartesian response support, and positive-prefix telescoping recovers linear district signatures. On \(\Theta_S\), a deterministic intervention query is uniformly identified exactly when its response indicator belongs to the tensor product of those signature row spaces: membership yields one denominator-safe rational functional, while nonmembership yields strictly positive rational same-support, same-law twins with different causal answers. Because those twins remain available in every semantics-preserving ambient class \(\mathcal M_S\supseteq\Theta_S\), identification in such a class implies tensor membership; the success direction is not transferred beyond \(\Theta_S\). The rational functional has fixed-face multinomial influence-function inference, while complete support-scoped do-search compilation remains open.
gap: Existing work either checks positivity for a formula, certifies selected constrained instances, or numerically optimizes over compatible response laws. It does not give a necessary-and-sufficient support-only criterion uniform over every same-law model on a realizable exact support face.
fill: The project proves support saturation, signature recovery, the tensor iff theorem, a rational formula-or-rational-twins dichotomy, and fixed-face multinomial inference, then asks whether signed product-preserving search rules can compile the semantic criterion without enumerating the full tensor.
